verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge stores agent-writable pages whose links form a graph, and Studio visualizes that link graph. This is a page-link graph, though, not a documented entity-and-relationship memory store with multi-hop or entity-centric querying. missing for 10: entity extraction from memories, typed relationships between entities, graph traversal or multi-hop query support, entity-centric retrieval APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable

citations.quote: These links make Knowledge a graph rather than a list of documents.
shows every scope and page as a tree beside a graph of how the pages link.
With Knowledge, an agent can not only read information but update it too, allowing it to learn and self-improve over time.
